places.name: Texas
places.note: Before even leaving it, camped some thirty miles north of Dallas, Jake hears the Suggses plot to steal a herd and kill its cowboys.

places.name: Dallas
places.note: Where Jake fell in with the Suggs brothers, met in a whorehouse; he fears being jailed there.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Two outlaws brought in by July Johnson await hanging in jail there; Jake fears being jailed there too.

places.name: Doan's Store
places.note: Trading post where Jake chats with a young nester wife, is clubbed by her old husband, and shoots him dead.
places.location_hint: on the Texas bank of the Red River, a day's ride north of a camp thirty miles north of Dallas

places.name: Red River
places.note: A herd crosses a mile west of the store; Jake flees across with the Suggses after the killing.

places.name: Indian Territory
places.note: The gang rides through without trouble, circling herds; Jake watches for the Hat Creek outfit to rejoin.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: The gang extorts four dollars from a German sod-house farmer, and Frog Lip runs his milk cows through the roof.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Dan wants to steal a herd near it and sell there; Jake hopes to slip away from the gang in its crowds.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Roy suggests heading there to rob banks.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: Home of the nester families heading to try Texas, including the girl Lou.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: The crowd from the store reminds Jake of people pouring out of saloons there after Benny Johnson died.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Jake hopes news of his killing might never reach there if he rejoins the Hat Creek outfit.

groups.label: Jake with the Suggs gang
groups.hint: riding north through Kansas settler country toward Dodge City
